newsitem.title: USA: Olympia & York gets receiver on NYC property.
newsitem.headline: Olympia & York gets receiver on NYC property.

text.p: Olympia & York Maiden Lane Finance Corp, a unit of Olympia & York Developments Ltd, said Wednesday that a New York court has appointed Mitchell Rudin as receiver to manage the property at 59 Maiden Lane in lower Manhattan.

The company had previously sought, and failed to find, a receiver for the property, which is the subject of a judgement of foreclosure, and on which the company has issued $200 million in bonds, indirectly secured by a first mortgage on the building.
Rudin is also an adviser to the bondholders.
The company also said that the receiver would pursue claims against the Home Insurance Co regarding the nonpayment of rent at the property.
